title: Always clean up the in-process daemon when recovery exit-test process cleanup fails
outcome: Always clean up the in-process daemon when recovery exit-test process cleanup fails
acceptance: Recovery exit-test cleanup always cancels and releases the in-process daemon, resets runtime mode and attempts endpoint cleanup even when process stop or stderr drain fails; original test failure is not masked by cleanup-only assertions.
disposal_reason: Greg requested implementation of these follow-ups after their optional parents completed; continue independently while preserving original review provenance.
